requires.label: Patient must be a Colorado resident
requires.quote: An individual must be a Resident of Colorado in order to qualify for Financial Assistance

requires.label: Patient must be uninsured or underinsured
requires.quote: The Patient is Uninsured or Under-insured

rules.label: Income-based assistance at or below 250% FPL
rules.quote: Patients approved for Financial Assistance with an annual Family Income of 250% of FPL guidelines or less will receive a 100% discount on gross charges for care covered by this policy

rules.label: Income-based assistance between 251% and 400% FPL
rules.quote: Patients approved for Financial Assistance with an annual Family Income between 251% and 400% of FPL guidelines will receive a discount on gross charges as outlined in Appendix A

rules.label: Presumptive Eligibility for Financial Assistance
rules.quote: Patients granted Presumptive Eligibility for Financial Assistance will receive a 100% discount on gross charges for care covered by this policy

application.quote: 365 days from the date of the first post-discharge Billing Statement
30 days after notice of the initiation of one or more Extraordinary Collection Actions has been provided

eca_not_before.quote: UCHealth will refrain from initiating ECAs for at least 365 days from the date the Hospital mails the first post-discharge Billing Statement
at least 30 days in advance of initiating ECAs

notes: Residency exception: For unscheduled emergency services, UCHealth may, at its sole discretion, make an exception to the residency requirement.
UCHealth employees residing outside Colorado but receiving services at a UCHealth facility do not have to meet residency requirements.
Services not covered: elective or cosmetic surgery; transplant procedures; self-pay packages; single case agreements; grants & research; services with legal obligation for third-party payment.
Provider coverage varies by facility; a separate Provider List is maintained and updated quarterly.
AGB (Amount Generally Billed) caps charges for FAP-eligible patients; self-pay discount applies if greater than AGB.
Presumptive eligibility only applies to current services and past accounts, not future services.
For patients non-responsive to screening, UCHealth may use a third-party predictive model to assess financial need when estimated household FPL is 250% or less.
UCHealth does not report patient debt to credit agencies nor place liens on patient property.
Family definition: group of two or more related by birth, marriage, or adoption residing together; family members not responsible for services to patients 18+.
Financial Resources: cash, bank deposits, or assets easily withdrawn without penalty (checking, savings, trusts, CDs).
Income verification documents required: paycheck stubs, bank statements, tax returns, W-2, unemployment letter, Social Security letter, grant letter, spousal maintenance documentation.

Residency documentation required: Colorado ID, pay stub with CO address, rental/mortgage statement, bank statement or utility bill mailed to CO address, other official document with name and CO address, or written attestation.
Application processing: completed applications processed within 14 days; written determination notice provided.
Eligibility validity: 365 days for income at or below 250% FPL; 180 days for income between 251-400% FPL.
Incomplete applications: denied with written notice; no ECAs initiated; 30 days to complete after notice.
Approved applications reverse ECAs and refund excess payments (except $1 or less).

Billing statements: at least 4 monthly statements mailed every 30 days; itemized statements provided within 10 business days of request, 30 days after discharge for inpatients, or 30 days after service for outpatients (whichever is later).
Collections referral: insured balances unpaid 120+ days; uninsured balances unpaid 182+ days; no action for 365 days from first statement may lead to ECAs.
All collection agencies must follow this policy.
Financial Counseling department has final authority on reasonable efforts determination for ECA initiation.
